tldr.description: One or two sentences: what the PR does and whether it is safe to merge.

files.description: Every changed file with its role. drift = changes the PR goal does not need; critical = auth, secrets, data migrations, deploy, CI.

notReviewed.description: Changed files you did not actually read, with the reason. Empty when you covered everything.

path.description: Repository-relative path of a file changed by the PR.

startLine.description: First line in the HEAD version of the file. Must be an added or context line of the diff.

endLine.description: Last line in the HEAD version, same hunk as startLine. Equal to startLine for a one-line finding.

severity.description: critical: data loss, security hole, broken deploy or prod outage. high: broken feature, wrong result, race. medium: works in the common case, fails in a real edge case. low: minor.

score.description: Confidence that this is real and worth the time of the author, after verification.

title.description: Short noun phrase naming the defect, at most ten words.

body.description: Markdown. What is wrong, the concrete input or path that triggers it, and what to do. At most five sentences.

evidence.description: Premise, path, verdict: what you read (file:line) that proves it, and what you searched for when claiming something is missing.

existingCode.description: Exact text of lines startLine..endLine at HEAD. Only together with improvedCode.

improvedCode.description: Complete replacement for existingCode, no ellipsis. Omit unless the fix is certain and at most 15 lines.
